Method of Attack: Leaking personal details of company employees via live chat widgets
Discoverer: Project Insecurity researchers Cody Zacharias and Kane Gamble
Impacted Systems: Sites managed by Google, Verizon, Spring, Bank of America, PayPal, Orange, Sony, Tesla, Bitdefender, Kaspersky Lab, Disney, and others using these widgets
Attack Vector: Live chat session interaction with support staffer
Indicators of Compromise: Leaky live chat widgets on hundreds of high-profile sites
Security advisory published by Project Insecurity
